ideas.truth: People want proof a brand is alive — a bold new colour feels like a small dose of good news.
ideas.moment: The instant a drop goes live and the colour itself is the headline, no context needed.
ideas.key_frame: The backpack alone, hero-lit on a warm gradient backdrop that mirrors its own colourway, like a launch poster.

ideas.truth: Everyday commuting can feel grey; people quietly want their gear to carry some personality through the day.
ideas.moment: Someone slinging the bag over one shoulder mid-stride, the colour cutting through a muted city street.
ideas.key_frame: Over-the-shoulder walking shot, backpack sharp, city blurred behind it.

ideas.truth: Fans of a brand's design language want to see the object worshipped like a considered piece, not just modeled.
ideas.moment: The bag presented like a collectible object the second it drops, no distractions.
ideas.key_frame: Studio-style pedestal shot, backpack centered against a bold sunray-toned backdrop, dramatic single light source.

why: It's a colour-drop announcement, not a lifestyle story — the product and its new hue should be the entire message, and this keeps the reference photo's product exact with zero invented human elements.
treatment: A single, confident product shot. The Transit Backpack 30L in Crypto Sunray stands centered against a warm gradient backdrop that echoes its own colour — like the bag is glowing from within. One clean studio light rakes across it, catching zipper pulls and fabric texture so the colour reads true and rich. The background eases into a soft, empty wash in the upper third, calm and uncluttered, ready to hold the announcement copy. No props, no people, no clutter — just the object as the news. It feels premium, immediate, and unmistakably a launch moment.

scenes.prompt: An Instagram product-ad photo of the exact backpack shown in the reference images, standing upright and centered on a warm sunray-orange to soft-yellow gradient backdrop that echoes its own 'Crypto Sunray' colourway. A single soft studio light rakes across the bag from the upper left, revealing fabric texture, zipper pulls, and clean, unmarked surfaces, with a soft grounded shadow beneath. The bag sits slightly left of center; the upper-right third of the frame stays calm, smooth, and uncluttered for text overlay. Premium, editorial, minimal product-launch style, high resolution, no props, no people.

finish.copy_placement: "New: Crypto Sunray" set in the calm upper-right gradient area as the primary headline; "mokobara.com" placed small and clean along the bottom edge as a footer/end card line.
finish.end_card: No separate end card needed — it's a single still; the bottom-line URL doubles as the sign-off.
finish.music: N/A — static image ad, no audio needed.
